name: claude-blog
description: AI-powered blog skill suite: 32 skill directories (1 orchestrator + 31 sub-skills) and 5 agents for writing, rewriting, auditing, and optimizing content for Google rankings and AI citations (GEO/AEO). Includes the FLOW framework, semantic topic-cluster planning, multilingual publishing, Google API integration, persona writing, fact-checking, cannibalization detection, CMS taxonomy, NotebookLM research, Gemini TTS narration, image generation, and 5-category quality scoring.

google_ai_api_key.title: Google AI API key (optional)
google_ai_api_key.description: Enables /blog image (Gemini image generation) and /blog audio (Gemini TTS). Leave blank to keep both disabled -- while blank, nothing is downloaded and no MCP server is started. Free key: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

gemini_image_model.title: Gemini image model
gemini_image_model.description: Model used for /blog image. Only takes effect once an API key is set.
